name: Poulan PLN1510
blurb: Oregon prints one chain under PLN1510: 10″ bar, 3/8″ low profile, .050″ gauge, 39 drive links (S39).
intro: Oregon's saw-chain selection guide prints Poulan PLN1510 on its own line with chain S39: 10″ bar, 39 drive links, .050″ gauge, 3/8″ low profile. 39 links is a pole-saw count on some other brands. Here Oregon prints it under PLN1510. The guide does not print a file size.

bars.note: Oregon prints S39 directly under Poulan PLN1510: 10″ bar, 39 drive links, .050″ gauge, 3/8″ low profile. No file size is printed.

sources.title: Oregon Saw Chain Selection Guide: model line printed with saw-chain code, bar length, drive links, gauge and pitch

sources_note: Oregon Saw Chain Selection Guide (https://apps.oregonproducts.com/pdfs/TSC-Chain-Fit-Guide.pdf), read 7 Nov 2026. The guide does not print a file size on these rows.
